questions.q: A sound wave has a frequency of 500 Hz and a wavelength of 0.68 m. What is its speed?
Which of these is a longitudinal wave?
questions.why: In sound the air particles vibrate parallel to the direction the wave travels; the others are transverse.

questions.q: Water waves pass through a gap in a barrier. When is the diffraction greatest?
options: when the gap is much wider than the wavelength
when the gap is about the same size as the wavelength
when the waves have a large amplitude
questions.why: Diffraction is most noticeable when the gap width is similar to the wavelength.

questions.q: A student stands 85 m from a tall wall and claps. She hears the echo 0.50 s later. Calculate the speed of sound.
points: distance doubled (to the wall and back) = 170 m
